title: Chapter 2926 - 167: Divine Priest_3
content:
Chapter 2926: Chapter 167: Divine Priest_3

The blood of the Vermilion Bird sealing the divine throne was incinerated.

The will of the Divine Way began to awaken, golden light spreading across the sky.

The golden tree atop the Divine Altar started to flourish.

In the unseen world of the Divine Way, Dao Laws circulated, and the golden Divine Authority Tree once again spread towards the sky, like the authority of a deity, overshadowing the heaven and earth.

And all authority was claimed by the fleshly body on the divine throne.

Mo Hua’s thin body sat atop the towering divine throne, several times larger than his own form.

Boundless majesty emanated from him, merging with the divine throne.

The golden divinity in his eyes became increasingly prominent, overshadowing the black from the Demon Evil Fate and the white from the Heavenly secret of Human Dao, taking dominance.

In that moment, he seemed to be seated on the Divine Altar, the Master of the Great Wilderness, controlling the Divine Way.

Ancient authority held within his grasp.

The sky-filled golden Divine Authority Tree, swayed gently with his every thought, spreading an extraordinarily brilliant light between heaven and earth.

However, without the power of divine descent rituals, to distort the boundary between reality, the vast majority of Barbarian Cultivators, with their mortal eyes, had no chance to witness the magnificent spectacle of the Divine Tree’s blooming.

Only a few like Yan Zhu could vaguely see the golden light at the horizon, and traces containing the markings of divine authority.

Just this little hint of Divine Way signs made these Upper Witches tremble in heart and soul.

And above the Divine Altar, when everything subsided, Mo Hua slowly rose, the gold receding in his eyes, divinity withdrawing within himself.

Yet the indifference and aloofness in his expression became more apparent.

Heaven and earth are unmoved, treating all things as straw dogs.

Deities are unmoved, treating all life as straw dogs.

His divinity nearly reached its peak.

Only occasionally did a hint of humanity reveal itself in his expressions.

The Big Tiger slowly walked to Mo Hua, looking at Mo Hua’s appearance, feeling both unfamiliar and worried.

Mo Hua extended his hand, gently caressing the Big Tiger’s head, softly murmuring:

"Only you are with me now..."

Truly from childhood to now, he who has a Cause and Effect "bond" with him, truly knowing, he is that "Mo Hua," and not some Great Wilderness Witch, at this moment, only the Big Tiger remains.

Only the Big Tiger can make Mo Hua remember, he is Mo Hua...

The Big Tiger affectionately rubbed against Mo Hua, its eyes clear and gentle.

...

Seven days later, the Grand Divine Sacrifice began.

This was the first grand ceremonial worship for the "Divine Lord," held in the Great Wilderness after countless years of the Divine Lord’s silence.

It was also the first time in the history of the Great Wilderness to worship the true "Divine Lord."

Mo Hua, with his flesh-body, sat on the high divine throne.

A Holy Beast of tiger, snow-white and bright, interspersed with black patterns, coiled beneath Mo Hua’s feet.

And below the throne, the Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger, alongside a group of ferocious Tiger Demons, all prostrated devoutly on the ground.

The impact of this scene, the shock it delivered, required no explanation.

Yan Zhu and others trembled in heart and soul.

The Great Chiefs of various tribes, Chief Elders, Barbarian Generals, all knelt down.

Beyond the square, millions of Barbarian warriors and Witch Cultivators, like a fierce wind flattening ocean waves, all knelt too.

Praise for the Divine Lord and the Shaman sounded from millions of mouths, echoing through heaven and earth.

Mo Hua gently raised his hand, and under divine majesty, all the clamor ceased, the world became silent, and millions of Barbarian Cultivators fell silent.

Mo Hua’s voice, gentle yet firm, carried the cold indifference of a deity:

"Today’s grand ceremony, to worship the Divine Lord, may the Divine Lord bless our Great Wilderness. May the great power of the Divine Lord protect our people of the Great Wilderness from famine and disaster."

"Starting today, the final divine war will be launched."

"This war must unify the Barbaric Wilderness. Let the Divine Lord’s renown spread across the heavens and earth of the Great Wilderness."

"Henceforth, those who believe in the Divine Lord shall live, those who do not shall drown in the bitter sea of the Endless Abyss, never to escape hardship in this life."

"And I, by the name of the Divine Lord, shall wield divine authority, as the highest Shaman below the Divine Lord..."

"After today, you may call me..."

Mo Hua’s eyes carried the majesty of ruling over all living things:

"Divine Blessing!"

In that moment, all bowed in worship, the people of Barbaric Wilderness devoutly knelt, shouted to the heavens:

"Lord of the Temple, live as long as the heavens and earth."

"Divine Blessing, shine as brightly as sun and moon."
